llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed image-generation CLI wrapper that sends prompts and chosen media files to dLazy’s cloud service.

dimensions.detail: Network calls to api.dlazy.com and file uploads to files.dlazy.com are disclosed and limited to prompts, parameters, and local paths the user passes for generation.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses a pinned npm package or npx alternative for @dlazy/cli@1.2.3; this is normal for a CLI-backed skill but users should trust the package source before installing.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Trigger phrases include generic image-generation terms, but they match the skill’s stated function and the external API behavior is disclosed.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Authentication stores a dLazy API key in ~/.dlazy/config.json, disclosed with revocation guidance; no background service, memory poisoning, privilege escalation, or hidden persistence was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The declared purpose is Nano Banana 2.0 image generation/editing, and the instructions consistently describe running the pinned dLazy CLI for that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable using dLazy’s hosted service. Prompts and any local image, video, or audio files you pass can be uploaded to dLazy, and the CLI may store an API key locally until you revoke or remove it.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: The scanner flagged the bilingual SKILL-cn.md reference as incomplete coverage; both referenced skill files were present and inspected.
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger phrases are real, but they are aligned with an image generation/editing skill and do not by themselves show hidden or purpose-mismatched behavior.
[P9] expected: The whitespace finding corresponds to wide Markdown table formatting in the error-handling section; manual review found no hidden instructions beyond the table and normal error guidance.
